drivingQuestion: When must an hourly laborer who worked at night be paid?
outcomeNote: Dispute stated; examined in the next unit

segments.he: שְׂכִיר שָׁעוֹת גּוֹבֶה כׇּל הַלַּיְלָה וְכׇל הַיּוֹם. אָמַר רַב: שְׂכִיר שָׁעוֹת דְּיוֹם – גּוֹבֶה כׇּל הַיּוֹם, שְׂכִיר שָׁעוֹת דְּלַיְלָה – גּוֹבֶה כׇּל הַלַּיְלָה. וּשְׁמוּאֵל אָמַר: שְׂכִיר שָׁעוֹת דְּיוֹם – גּוֹבֶה כׇּל הַיּוֹם, וּשְׂכִיר שָׁעוֹת דְּלַיְלָה – גּוֹבֶה כׇּל הַלַּיְלָה וְכׇל הַיּוֹם.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that «an hourly laborer collects» his wages «all night and all day. Rav says: An hourly laborer» who worked «by day collects» his wages «all» that «day,» while «an hourly laborer» who worked «by night collects» his wages «all» that «night. And Shmuel says: An hourly laborer» who worked «by day» indeed «collects» his wages «all» that «day, but an hourly laborer by night collects» his wages «all» that «night and all» the following «day.»
